title: Stacked Stone Colors | Custom Colored Faux Stone | GenStone
description: GenStone offers custom colored faux stone! Click here to learn about our stacked stone colors and the custom stone veneer process.
text:
New! GenStone Announces Custom-Colored Faux Stone

Until now, GenStone has offered our customers their choice of six beautiful, natural-looking faux stone color options—Kenai, Stratford, Desert Sunrise, Iron Ore, Keystone, and Coffee. We’ve always known that while these color options are suitable for most faux stone projects, an even better option for our customers would be to allow them to choose their own color.

But, there were many logistical and technological reasons why this kind of alternative simply wasn’t feasible…

…until now!!

GenStone is proud to announce that we are now giving our customers the freedom to choose the color they want for their faux stone panels. We are excited about this, because it’s going to open up a whole new world of design possibilities while giving our customers yet more value from the already high-quality, durable faux stone panels we’ve become known for supplying.

In order to make custom-colored faux stone panels an option for GenStone customers, we had to invest heavily into a technology-driven process that would make it easy and fast for our customers. Today, we’re unveiling this process and we’re now ready to work with you to develop a truly customized, colored-to-suit faux stone solution you’ll love.

How It Works

Ordering custom-colored GenStone faux stone panels, pillar kits, ledgers, and trim is simple.

Here are the steps involved in the process:

1.Find the faux stone color of your choice using your favorite image search, DIY project website, or other online platform. Some great examples to consider are Google Images , Houzz , Pinterest , Instagram , and istockphoto . Remember: the image you select doesn’t have to be faux stone. It could be real natural stone—the choice is yours!

2. Send your image to us using our contact form or email address. After we receive your image, we’ll get to work on creating a detailed rendering of the panels, kits, ledgers, or trim you need, colored exactly how you want it. Don’t forget to specify which GenStone faux stone products your project is calling for.

3. Purchase the completed rendering for a small, one-time fee. You’ll pay us a minimal charge for the time it takes us to develop a professional rendering of what your customized faux stone solution is going to look like.

4. Approve the rendering. Our support staff loves working with our customers to ensure that their faux stone is a perfect match for the vision they have of their interior or exterior faux stone project. After you’ve received your rendering, just let us know if it’s going to work for you, and we’ll be ready for manufacturing.

5. Place the order for your custom-colored GenStone. Keep in mind that our new, customized faux stone panels are going to be manufactured-to-order. While this may take more time, we promise it will be worth the wait!

6. Receive your new GenStone faux stone panels, and install them just as you would with any of our other faux stone products. It’s that easy!

Now, before you fire up your search engine and head out looking for just the right faux stone color, let us tell you about an exciting promotion that we’re including with this incredible announcement: free faux stone!

Your Customized Faux Stone Could Be Free!

What could possibly be better than getting strong, lightweight, waterproof, custom-colored faux stone from America’s #1 faux stone provider? Why, getting it for free , of course!

As part of our 2021 product line-up, we’re going to be including a custom color selected by one of our customers. If we choose your custom color, your entire faux stone order will be free!

All you have to do is place an order for custom-colored GenStone faux stone between now and the end of 2020, and you’ll be entered into the contest. If we select your color, we’ll send you a check for the amount you paid for your order.

We’re excited to see what colors you select for your dream faux stone project. And, we’re looking forward to working with you to make sure that your custom-colored faux stone is a perfect representation of the vision you have for your indoor or outdoor space.

Have questions about how to install GenStone faux stone panels? Head over to our ‘How to Install’ page for some answers. Or, if you’re looking for some inspiration from others’ completed faux stone projects, check out our ‘Projects’ page.

We’re confident that you’ll love the new custom-coloring option now available from GenStone.

What will your completed faux stone project look like? We can’t wait to see it for ourselves!
